verdict.rationale: Simular's own marketing states that Sai, once taught, 'reruns on a schedule' (simular-docs-15). It also supports saving replayable, parameterized skills (simular-docs-8) and keeps running after you close the laptop (simular-docs-16). That makes recurring execution a first-party claim, but it rests on a single marketing line with no documentation of how schedules are set up or managed. missing for 10: documented schedule configuration (cron/interval syntax, UI or API endpoint for creating and managing schedules), programmatic scheduling via the Sai API/MCP, run history for scheduled jobs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
